_doc: Chain-scoped tables (those carrying a chain_id column) that a Diamond change on that chain does NOT reset. Everything else with chain_id is reset by src/deploymentEpoch.ts when the bundle's Diamond differs from the adopted one. Keep an entry only for rows that are the USER's, not the chain's, or an operator record that names its own Diamond and that nothing joins to live ids: a loan- or offer-keyed row left over from a retired Diamond would be read against the fresh Diamond's restarted ids. The classification guard (scripts/check-table-classification.mjs) refuses an entry that names a table without chain_id or one that does not exist.

keep.diag_errors: frontend error captures — the page's own diagnostics, keyed by chain only for filtering; nothing in them is a chain object
keep.loan_orphans: the operator's record of loan rows withdrawn because the chain had no such loan (#2197); each entry names the Diamond it is about and nothing reads it against live ids, and a replay cannot recreate it, so a redeploy must not erase it
keep.support_tickets: durable user support requests (#1040); user content, and a ticket about a retired Diamond is still the user's ticket
keep.telegram_links: user Telegram chat links, keyed by chain for the user's own subscriptions; a redeploy must not unlink anyone
keep.user_thresholds: user-supplied HF alert thresholds, keyed by chain for the user's own alerts; the deploy script's purge excluded it by name for the same reason
